items.text: Seattle FINAL: QB Sam Darnold (quad/ribs) OUT; Drew Lock starts, as the schedule lists. Also OUT - LT Charles Cross (ankle), G Quenton Nelson (knee, week-to-week after procedure), WR Rashid Shaheed (knee), DT Leonard Williams (stinger), LB Uchenna Nwosu (ankle), DT Brandon Pili (back). LB Connor O'Toole (foot) questionable.

Arizona FINAL: OUT - RB Bam Knight (concussion), OL Jon Gaines II (ankle), OT Jayden Williams (knee). Questionable - G Isaiah Adams (ankle), DL Walter Nolen III (ankle), CB Max Melton (knee). Gardner Minshew starts (Jacoby Brissett reportedly traded). RB Jeremiyah Love on IR.
